title: What a Blockchain Bridge Is
summary: A bridge lets assets or information move between two separate blockchains that cannot talk to each other directly.
blocks: A bridge lets assets or information move between two separate blockchains that cannot talk to each other directly.
It typically locks an asset on one chain and represents it on the other, so you can use it in a different ecosystem.
Bridges are useful but have historically been a target for large hacks, because they concentrate a lot of value in complex contracts. Understanding that risk is part of using them.
